Tantras then called the final Fog Monster off. {{source|Den vs Harrison}}

full_text:
The Fog Monsters are ghostly incantations made up of smoke that are conjured by the Blood Spiral master, Tantras, to train his new recruits in mastering their Titans in combat.

History

Tantras summoned four Fog Monsters in Rotterdam at the orphanage of Den and Harrison Fears whilst training them and the other orphans in the use of their Titans. Dirk ordered his Harlekin to defeat one of the monsters while Harrison ordered his Marauder to hold one down before he destroyed it with a Nullcurse. Bruno panicked and was saved by his Harlekin whilst Den crouched to the ground in fright, unable to invoke his Marauder as he could not bond with such a dark Titan. Tantras then called the final Fog Monster off. [Den vs Harrison]

Abilities

Despite their terrifying appearance, the Fog Monsters were relatively easy to defeat, being defeated by a single swipe from a Harlekin. [Den vs Harrison]

Gallery

Image caption: Concept Art

Image caption: Tantras creates a Fog Monster

Image caption: Fog Moster

Trivia

• The Fog Monsters were not named onscreen but behind the scenes concept art names them such.
